entities.name: Idle/Inactive Mode Measurements
entities.description: Procedure for UE to perform measurements on NR and E-UTRA carriers while in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE state when specific timer conditions are met.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC idle state where UE performs idle mode measurements.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC inactive state where UE performs inactive mode measurements.

entities.name: T331
entities.description: Timer that must be running for UE to perform idle/inactive measurements.

entities.name: T319a
entities.description: Timer that must NOT be running for UE to perform idle/inactive measurements.

entities.name: VarMeasIdleConfig
entities.description: Configuration containing measurement parameters for idle/inactive mode, including carrier lists and measurement settings.

entities.name: measIdleCarrierListEUTRA
entities.description: List of E-UTRA carriers for idle/inactive measurements.

entities.name: measIdleCarrierListNR
entities.description: List of NR carriers for idle/inactive measurements.

entities.name: VarMeasIdleReport
entities.description: Storage for measurement results collected during idle/inactive mode.

entities.name: NE-DC Support Condition
entities.description: Condition that UE supports NE-DC between serving carrier and E-UTRA carrier frequency.

entities.name: Carrier Aggregation/NR-DC Support Condition
entities.description: Condition that UE supports carrier aggregation or NR-DC between serving carrier and NR carrier frequency.

entities.name: Measurement Performance
entities.description: UE performs measurements according to configured parameters and stores results in measurement report.

relations.description: Procedure requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE state.
Procedure requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state.
Procedure requires timer T331 to be running.
Procedure requires timer T319a NOT to be running.
Procedure uses VarMeasIdleConfig for measurement configuration.
VarMeasIdleConfig contains E-UTRA carrier list for measurements.
VarMeasIdleConfig contains NR carrier list for measurements.
Procedure stores measurement results in VarMeasIdleReport.
E-UTRA carrier measurements require NE-DC support condition.
NR carrier measurements require carrier aggregation/NR-DC support condition.
Procedure establishes measurement performance property when conditions are met.
